messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate detected in ap-east gateway cluster since 09:12 UTC. metric: /v1/generate 5xx rate = 12%. Paging oncall: @maria. Link: https://metrics.redwood/ap-east/5xx
maria (oncall): I got the page, taking lead. pulling dashboards and runbook A.2. will post initial findings.
kevin (eng-sre): i'm awake and available — handing off to you, maria. share pool health when you have it.
maria (oncall): quick head-up: proxy pool ap-east-proxy-pool-3 has conn usage 87%, backlog rising, upstream errors show "connection reset by peer" from ml-worker-egress. KV cache miss is steady. Latency spikes on long requests (~>2s).
sasha (netops): seeing NAT egress metrics for ap-east-nat-2: conntrack entries climbing fast, ephemeral port exhaustion risk. tcp_retries and retransmit spikes from nat node set 2.
ben (support): customers reporting timeouts on hosted endpoints in ap-east. Customer-facing error rate from status page ~11%. Internal routing shows retries but many end with 502.
maria (oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) increase circuit breaker thresholds briefly to reduce tripping noise, 2) steer partial traffic to eu-west while we drain problematic pool, 3) scale/replace nat nodes. prefer traffic-steer 25-35% to eu-west as quick relief.
kevin (eng-sre): agreed. initiating traffic steer 30% and raising cb to 0.85. will exclude enterprise customers on the "no-cross-region" list.
kevin (eng-sre): ```
# trafficctl (internal fabric CLI)
steer --from region=ap-east --to region=eu-west --ratio=0.3 --reason "ap-east conn saturation"
config set /proxy/ap-east/circuit_breaker_threshold 0.85
# add exclusion for tagged customers
steer --from region=ap-east --to region=eu-west --ratio=0.3 --exclude-tag "no-cross-region"
```
deploy-bot: trafficctl request accepted (id=tc-1990011222-01). routing change scheduled immediate. :white_check_mark:
sasha (netops): I'm bumping conntrack max on ap-east-nat-2 and starting a rolling replace for the worst nat pods. sysctl change applied on node: `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` — monitoring.
maria (oncall): note: double-check compliance for cross-region for enterprise customers.
tim (compliance): confirmed: two enterprise customers (acct-eu-123, acct-priv-9) opted out of cross-region. kevin, you handled exclusion rule? please confirm.
kevin (eng-sre): exclusion applied — trafficctl returned success. steering observes ~30% traffic shifted off ap-east now. watching metrics.
maria (oncall): 5m after steering: ap-east 5xx dropped to ~6%. latency tail improving. backup pool still shows resets; continuing drains on pool-3.
ben (support): drafting status page:
"We are experiencing elevated error rates for some requests in the ap-east region. Mitigation underway: partial traffic reroute to eu-west and infra scaling. Customers in control-plane enforced \"no-cross-region\" will not be rerouted. We will post updates every 15 minutes."
ben (support): posting in status-redwood now. :loudspeaker:
maria (oncall): action items: 1) kevin continue steering and monitor canary success metrics (errors, latency, token cost), 2) sasha finish nat node replacement and confirm connection stability, 3) ben coordinate customer comms for impacted tenants, 4) tim verify compliance for any postmortem traffic moves.
kevin (eng-sre): rolling restart of ap-east-proxy pods with graceful drain initiated (command below). will avoid full pool outage.
kevin (eng-sre): ```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/ap-east-proxy --grace-period=60 --max-unavailable=1
# watch for pod READY and connection reestablishment
kubectl get pods -n redwood | grep ap-east-proxy
```
sasha (netops): nat replacements are up; conntrack dropped to safe range. downstream resets decreased significantly after node swap.
maria (oncall): looks stable at 15:05 UTC. 5xx steady at ~2-3% (within SLO burst tolerance). leaving kevin and sasha to own remediation. i'll remain connected until full recovery and then write incident timeline.
kevin (eng-sre): will continue monitoring and collect logs for pool-3 upstream resets. starting deeper diag with ml-worker team (tagging @mlinfra).
ben (support): customers updated; one enterprise asked for an RCA once we have it.
maria (oncall): Handoff: maria -> kevin (mitigation owner) and sasha (infra owner). Oncall rotation note: next oncall at 17:00 UTC is @alex, will be looped in for postmortem.
maria (oncall): preliminary RCA hypothesis: ap-east nat node exhaustion + a degraded ml-worker subset causing connection resets and proxy backlog leading to increased 5xx. mitigation: conntrack bump + nat node replacement + partial cross-region steering + graceful proxy restart.
kevin (eng-sre): logging action items into incident tracker: INC-1990011222. tagging for postmortem and model-team follow-up.
maria (oncall): thanks all, keeping thread open for updates. who wants to draft the post-incident summary? I'll start the timeline and initial metrics snapshot. :eyes:
kevin (eng-sre): I'll take postmortem writeup with sasha. will include timelines, config diffs, and proposed infra hardening (auto-scale nat, conntrack alerting, better exclusion UX for reroute).
ben (support): closing loop with customers once we have RCA draft. tagging in support tickets.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: severity downgraded to SEV-2 at 15:12 UTC. continued monitoring recommended."
